source:
@@U01172@@
Our little 格蕾琴 pulls a long face, and thinks:
“It’s a gift horse, after all;
and how can the man nice enough to bring it,
whoever he is, be bad?”
So off her mother sends for one of those priests,
and no sooner he understands the joke
and likes what he sees, he says:
“That's the spirit!” he says.
“Who conquers his greed wins big.
The church has a marvelous digestion:
its gobbled up whole countries,
and never been glutted.
The church alone, dear ladies,
can digest ill-gotten goods.”

@@U01174@@
Nothing new there;
a king can do it the same as any Jew.

@@U01176@@
With that,
he pockets the necklace, brooches, and rings
as if they were so many mushrooms,
thanking them neither more nor less
than if he'd pocketed a bag of nuts.
Promising them their reward in Heaven,
he left then feeling edified.

@@U01178@@
And 格蕾琴?

@@U01180@@
She sits there restless,
not knowing what to do or how,
thinking day and night of the jewels,
but even more about him who brought them.
translation:
@@U01172@@
我们的小格蕾琴拉长了脸，心想：
“毕竟，这是一匹礼物马；
那个好心的人怎么能把它带来，
不管他是谁，都是坏人吗？”
于是她母亲派人去找一位牧师，
他一听懂这个笑话
他喜欢他所看到的，他说：
“这就是精神！”他说。
“谁战胜了自己的贪婪，谁就赢得了大胜利。
教会有一个奇妙的消化能力：
它吞噬了整个国家，
并且从未被饱和。
亲爱的女士们，只有教堂，
能消化不义之财。”

@@U01174@@
那里没有什么新鲜事；
国王可以像任何犹太人一样做到这一点。

@@U01176@@
就这样，
他把项链、胸针和戒指装进口袋
就好像它们是很多蘑菇一样，
对他们的感谢不多也不少
比他把一袋坚果装进口袋还要好。
许诺他们在天堂的奖赏，
他离开时感觉受到了启发。

@@U01178@@
还有格蕾琴？

@@U01180@@
她坐在那里坐立不安
不知道该做什么或如何做，
日夜思念珠宝，
但更多的是关于带来它们的人。
